messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering-high-latency triggered by alert 'metering_emitter_latency > 120s' (sev: P1). Routing to oncall (Nadia O).
Nadia O: on it, grabbing context. paging Ajay (SRE) and Chris (billing) — tagging for potential customer impact.
Ajay R: looking. I see a big tail in emitter ack times and increased Kafka consumer lag on topic 'tokens-aggregator'.
Maria G: Customer portal flagged multiple overage emails at ~12:42 UTC, finance is getting calls. Are we sure this is a real count increase vs delayed emit? :eyes:
Chris L: initial read: usage counts spiked across multiple customers at 12:40-12:45, but token generation rates from runtime nodes don't match that spike. Suspect double-counting or late batches.
Sylvia T: pulling ingestion logs now — I'm seeing repeated replays from emitter service: many messages have identical trace_id and slightly different offsets. Could be retry logic duplicating messages after acks time out.
Nadia O: timeline: alert at 12:37, customer emails 12:42, I'm on a call with support. Need quick mitigation: stop sending out automated overage flags + prevent further double-emits.
Ajay R: can we pause the emitter to stop new writes to the aggregation topic? That will prevent further inflation while we triage.
Chris L: Acceptable short-term. Pause emitter -> switch aggregator into a protective de-dup mode if possible. If we pause emitter, we need a safe drain plan so we don't lose legitimate usage.
Maria G: Support: please hold all outbound overage emails (we can flip the flag in prod) — don't want customers panicking. I'm updating support template: "We are investigating billing discrepancies, no action required from customers."
incident-bot: Action queued: postmortem channel created (#incidents-3281004321) by Nadia O.
Ajay R: command run: `kubectl scale deployment/emitter --replicas=0 -n prod` -> scaling down emitter pods now.
Sylvia T: confirming consumer lag: offsets stopped moving post-scale, but backlog remains. I'm enabling aggregator dedupe: `AGG_DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS=60000` via config flip on aggregator pods.
Chris L: are we able to recompute counts for the window 12:30-12:50 using raw logs to produce a corrected view? Finance wants numbers for the calls they have.
Ajay R: yes, we can run a fast reconcile job that reduces duplicates by trace_id + request_ts fuzzy-match. I'll kick it off on a low-priority worker pool.
Maria G: Good. Also let's create a temporary rule to suppress overage billing actions (credits, charge runs) until reconciliation completes. Finance Ops Bot, FYI.
Finance Ops Bot: Acknowledged. Suspending automated charge triggers for affected window 12:30-13:00 UTC.
Nadia O: quick status: emitter paused, dedupe on aggregator enabled, recon job started. Next: root cause exploration. Ajay, can you share kernel/GC or network anomalies?
Ajay R: node-level metrics look fine. Timeout pattern points to a recent bump in emitter batch size combined with a race in the ack path. If ack path times out, emitter retries individual messages which then get reindexed by aggregator as new.
Sylvia T: I pulled sample messages. Example duplicated payload (trace_id: 0x7a9c): same content, different kafka offset, timestamp delta ~4s. Aggregator indexed both.
Maria G: Oof. That matches customer reports. Chris, estimate potential worst-case overcount?
Chris L: ballpark from sample: about 1.6x in the worst affected minute for some customers. We'll need to compute per-customer deltas before issuing credits.
Ajay R: ETA on reconcile job? Running now on 4 workers; current projection 22 minutes to finish 24h tail for affected partitions (we prioritize 12:20-13:00 window).
Nadia O: good. Meanwhile, can we prevent analytics probes or downstream systems from re-ingesting the backlog and re-triggering alerts?
Ajay R: I'll add a temporary filter in the forwarder: `if message.timestamp < 13:05 && message.trace_seen == true -> drop` — implements simple dedupe by trace_id cache. Deploying now.
incident-bot: Deploy started for forwarder-filter on cluster prod (deploy/forwarder-filter v2026.3.28).
Sylvia T: reconcile job progress: 45% through window; duplicates collapsed so far ~38k messages; estimated corrected token delta -12M tokens across customers in sample partitions.
Maria G: Finance is on the call. They want to know which customers received overage emails and whether to proactively credit them. Chris, assemble a list of customers who saw >10% delta.
Chris L: working that list now. Also prepping a short customer comms draft for support to use if needed.
Nadia O: short-term ops runbook update: 1) Ensure emitter remains paused until we confirm safe drain and patch. 2) Keep aggregator dedupe enabled for 2 hours post-fix. 3) Suppress overage emails and charge triggers until finance approves reconciled numbers.
Ajay R: root cause: regression in retry logic introduced in commit `abc123` two days ago — changed ack timeouts combined with batch size increase. Repro steps in dev: emulate ack delay -> duplicates seen. I'll prepare a patch to revert the retry behavior and add idempotency keys to outgoing messages.
Sylvia T: patch will be quick. I'll also add a counter in aggregator to emit dedupe rate metric (`agg.dedupe.rate`) so we can monitor if duplicates appear again.
Maria G: Support update posted: "We've paused billing notifications while we reconcile counts. No customer action needed. We'll reach out after validation." :thumbsup:
Finance Ops Bot: Reconcile job progress telemetry: 65% done. Preliminary estimate: total customer impact across billing window ~ -9.8M tokens (i.e., previous counts were inflated).
Chris L: list ready: 18 customers had >10% inflation (IDs truncated: CUST-**9F, CUST-**2X, CUST-**7M...). I recommend outreach to top 10 by ARR first.
Nadia O: good. We will not issue automatic credits yet. Finance please review the reconciled numbers and authorize credits or message.
Finance Ops Bot: Noted — awaiting final reconciliation -> will respond with action list.
Ajay R: patch PR opened: `revert/ack-retries` with fix + test. Plan: after merge, deploy to canary, monitor dedupe.metric for 15m, then re-enable emitter at lower batch size.
Sylvia T: reconcile job completed. Final corrected delta: -10,123,456 tokens in the affected window. Deduped messages: 42,719.
Maria G: solid. Chris L, finance: ready to proceed?
Chris L: Finance approves credits for customers with >5% inflation and automatic notifications for >10%. I'm drafting messages for top 10 customers.
Nadia O: plan for re-enable: 1) merge patch, 2) deploy canary, 3) monitor `agg.dedupe.rate` and emitter ack latency for 30m, 4) scale emitter to 25% for 10m, 5) full scale if stable.
Ajay R: patch merged. Deploying canary now.
incident-bot: Canary deployed (deploy/emitter:v2026.3.28-rc1).
Sylvia T: monitoring: `agg.dedupe.rate` at 0.1% on canary traffic, ack latencies back to baseline. No new duplicate clusters.
Maria G: support and finance queues updated. Communicating to affected customers with proposed credits this hour.
Chris L: sending top-customer comms now. Template: "We detected a metering bug that temporarily inflated usage in window 12:30-12:50 UTC. We have corrected counts and applied credits where applicable. Please reach out if you see discrepancies."
Nadia O: closing notes for now: incident downgraded to mitigation/completed once emitter fully resumed and metrics stable for 30m. Postmortem owner: Ajay R. Action items assigned: revert in prod (done), add idempotency keys (in PR), improve canary gating and add `agg.dedupe.rate` alert.
Maria G: thanks everyone for fast coordination. Lessons: avoid batch-size bump near critical release windows, ensure dedupe window in aggregator by default.
Ajay R: will author postmortem with timeline, root cause, impact numbers, and remediation steps.
incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> Postmortem scheduled (48h).
Nadia O: closing channel for active paging. I'll keep #incidents-3281004321 for postmortem discussion. :white_check_mark:
